Description

AbstractPbcsObject
Base class for PBCS object implementations that make REST calls, providing shared helpers for issuing GET/POST requests relative to the object's REST context.
AccessToken
Represents an access token that can be used to authenticate calls to the PBCS REST API.

Simple, immutable AccessToken implementation that wraps a raw token value.

AggregateMemberResolver
A PbcsPlanType.MemberResolver that delegates to a list of other resolvers, checking each in order and returning the first non-null result.
AifApplication
Maps the application details returned by the unofficial data management (DM/AIF) "applications" endpoint, including the up to six plan names an application can have, which of those plans each dimension is valid for, and any additional application properties.
AifAppProperty
Maps a single application property as returned alongside application details by the unofficial data management (DM/AIF) "applications" endpoint.
AifDimension
Maps a single dimension entry as returned by the unofficial data management (DM/AIF) "applications" endpoint, describing the dimension's name, its balance column name, its class, and which of an application's up to six plans the dimension is valid for.
AliasedMember
Maps a single node of the member tree returned by the REST API's Get Dimension Details endpoint (GET applications/{app}/plantypes/{cube}/dimensions/{dimName}) when requested with fields=name,alias,children, optionally together with an aliasTableName query parameter.
Api
Describes a single version of the REST API, as returned by the API's root/discovery endpoint.
Application

Applications
Maps the response of the REST API's applications list endpoint, wrapping the list of Application entries.

Maps a single application snapshot (backup) entry as returned by the interop (LCM) service, such as an LCM export archive or an externally uploaded file.

ApplicationSnapshotInfoWrapper
A concrete AbstractHypermediaResponse of ApplicationSnapshotInfo items, used so Jackson has a non-generic type to deserialize the interop (LCM) service's snapshot info list responses into.
ApplicationSnapshotsWrapper
A concrete AbstractHypermediaResponse of ApplicationSnapshot items, used so Jackson has a non-generic type to deserialize the interop (LCM) service's snapshot list responses into.
